title: Raymond Larsen vs. Pacific Presbytery (Complaint)
disposition_detail: Case 97-10, Raymond Larsen's complaint against Pacific Presbytery, was withdrawn by the complainant, and the withdrawal was recorded together with the companion matter 97-12 (also Larsen vs. Pacific Presbytery), likewise withdrawn. No merits ruling, findings, or reasons appear; no separate merits opinion was published.
first_summary: Raymond Larsen's complaint against Pacific Presbytery (Case 97-10) was withdrawn by the complainant, and the Assembly recorded the withdrawal along with that of his companion Case 97-12. No merits opinion was published.
summary: Raymond Larsen's complaint against Pacific Presbytery (Case 97-10) was withdrawn by the complainant before any merits ruling, and the Assembly recorded that withdrawal at its next stated meeting. His companion Case 97-12, also against Pacific Presbytery, was withdrawn at the same time. No separate merits opinion was published, so the record supplies only the disposition and no reasons, facts, or relief.
